scope: All declared depends_on / requires / blocks fields across MS0, MS1, MS4, MS5 (MS2/MS3 use narrative dependency tables, not declared depends_on fields per-unit)
method: Parsed every depends_on edge from MS0 unit tables (61 units, Phases 0-8) and MS1 unit bodies (U-SUB-00..U-SUB-43) and MS4 unit bodies (U-DRIFT-*, U-REV-AUDIT-*). Built implied DAG mentally; verified each target id exists in spec; detected cross-MS direction violations; flagged orphans (zero in-degree AND zero out-degree in own milestone) and prose-only deps (mentioned in sequencing prose but absent from depends_on field).

totals.skipped_reason: MS2 uses narrative track tables without per-unit declared depends_on fields. MS3 uses batch sequencing prose. MS5/MS6 not within first 850 lines; assumed similar structure.

findings.title: MS0 ADMIN units do NOT declare depends_on against MS1 hoist set despite prose claiming they MUST
findings.detail: Line 198 states 'U-SUB-00, U-SUB-19, U-SUB-22, U-SUB-28 MUST land before MS0 paywall units activate.' Line 259-263 reiterates webhook/tax/SOC2 gates. Yet MS0 Phase 7 units (U-REV-ADMIN-03 BillingPortal, U-REV-ADMIN-07 SubscriptionTierEditor) declare depends_on only U-REV-MS0-ACT-SUBTIER-01 / U-REV-MS0-HOIST-ADMIN-01 — NEITHER references U-SUB-00/19/22/28. This is the textbook MS-order violation flagged in the brief: MS0 unit prose-depends on MS1 unit but DAG field is silent.
findings.fix: Add explicit depends_on: ['U-SUB-00','U-SUB-22','U-SUB-28'] to U-REV-MS0-ACT-SUBTIER-01 and U-REV-MS0-ACT-APIKEY-01; rename 'MS0 ships first' framing — MS1 P0 hoist set (U-SUB-00/19/22/28/04) is a true prereq of MS0 paywall pages.

findings.title: U-SUB-04 listed as P0 hoist but its depends_on chain is never declared
findings.detail: Line 525 names U-SUB-04 (License-validator middleware) as one of the 5 P0 hoist units that 'must merge before MS0 paywall lights up.' U-SUB-04 is listed in the v1 carryover table (L497) with NO depends_on field shown. It implicitly requires U-SUB-00 (dispatcher scaffold) and U-SUB-03 (FeatureTierEngine). Without declared edges, the Stop-hook DAG can't enforce ordering.
findings.fix: Add depends_on: ['U-SUB-00','U-SUB-03'] in carryover table or expand U-SUB-04 to a full unit block.

findings.title: 11 MS1 units are leaf orphans — no other unit depends on them
findings.detail: These units have OUT-edges but ZERO IN-edges (nobody declares depends_on them) AND they are not the MS1-close acceptance gate. They are not in critical path through MS0 paywall activation or MS1 acceptance bullets 1-7.
findings.note: U-SUB-42 (pairwise matrix) IS named in acceptance gate L535 so partial credit — but no peer unit declares depends_on U-SUB-42. Same for U-SUB-29 named at L537. Acceptance-gate-only references should still surface as declared edges to keep the DAG honest.
findings.fix: Either (a) add explicit MS1-close meta-unit with depends_on: [...all 43] or (b) declare reverse edges from downstream consumers (e.g. EU GTM launch unit depends_on U-SUB-23/24/25).

findings.title: Carryover units marked 'thin shim — replaced' retain v1 IDs with no depends_on, creating phantom DAG nodes
findings.detail: U-SUB-09, U-SUB-12, U-SUB-13, U-SUB-15 are tagged '(replaced by U-SUB-36 / U-SUB-33/34 / U-SUB-22..25 / U-SUB-39/40/41)' in the carryover table (L502, L505-508). They count in 'Net effective unit count: 43' (L513) but no peer unit can sensibly depend on them. They are zombies in the DAG.
findings.fix: Either drop from active unit count (43 -> 39) or mark status: deprecated in envelope schema and exclude from DAG. Leaving them as ghost rows triggers Stop-hook false-positives.

findings.title: MS4 audit fan-in declares depends_on [U-DRIFT-01,U-DRIFT-02] redundantly across 3 audit children + 1 synthesis
findings.detail: U-REV-AUDIT-SFC-01, U-REV-AUDIT-MASTERPOST-01, U-REV-AUDIT-CAM-BRIDGE-01 each declare depends_on: ['U-DRIFT-01','U-DRIFT-02']. U-REV-AUDIT-SYNTHESIS-01 declares depends_on on those three. The synthesis edge already transitively covers DRIFT-01/02, so the duplication is harmless but verbose. Not a bug — flag as cosmetic.
findings.fix: Optional cleanup; current form is explicit and DAG-correct.

findings.title: Zero cycles in the entire declared DAG
findings.detail: Traced every declared edge: MS0 (61 units, ~70 edges), MS1 (43 units, ~25 edges), MS4 (8 units, ~10 edges). All edges flow forward Phase 0 -> Phase 8 in MS0; U-SUB-00 -> downstream in MS1; U-DRIFT-* -> AUDIT-* -> SYNTHESIS in MS4. Confirmed acyclic.

findings.title: Zero unresolved references in declared depends_on fields
findings.detail: Every unit ID appearing as a depends_on target is itself defined as a unit in the spec. No ghost IDs (e.g. no depends_on references to U-SUB-44 or U-REV-MS0-XYZ-99 that don't exist). Spec's per-unit ID hygiene is clean.

findings.title: U-REV-MS0-ACT-SUBTIER-01 prose references Stripe but has no declared dep on tax bridge
findings.detail: Acceptance text (L59) says 'tier upgrade/downgrade round-trip via Stripe sandbox; prorate flag honored.' Prorate logic lives in U-SUB-30 (ProrationEngine, L380) and tax compliance in U-SUB-22. Neither is declared as a depends_on. If MS0 SUBTIER ships before MS1 SUB-22/30, the Stripe round-trip will emit non-tax-compliant invoices to EU/UK customers.
findings.fix: Add depends_on: ['U-SUB-00','U-SUB-22','U-SUB-30'] to U-REV-MS0-ACT-SUBTIER-01. OR explicitly scope MS0 SUBTIER acceptance to US-only.

verdict.headline: DAG is structurally acyclic and reference-clean, but suffers from 2 hard cross-milestone-order violations (R5A4-001, R5A4-008) and 11 declared-leaf orphans in MS1 that prevent the Stop-hook DAG from enforcing the spec's own sequencing prose.

coverage_note: MS2 / MS3 / MS5 / MS6 sections use narrative dependency tables (track-based, batch-based) rather than per-unit declared depends_on fields. They are NOT graph-verifiable with the same rigor and were excluded from cycle/orphan detection. A follow-up unit should normalize them into the same depends_on schema as MS0/MS1/MS4 so the entire roadmap is uniformly DAG-checkable.
